items.title: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.26995v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. In contrast, flat semantic retrieval treats skills as independent text entries, ignoring dependencies, execution order, state transitions, and data flow constraints. items.title: Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Reduce Hallucination in Clinical Tasks?
items.summary: arXiv:2610.27027v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems improve performance on clinical tasks, and that improvement is often read as evidence of a more trustworthy system. items.title: Beyond the KV cache: Training and serving i14’s Laplace 3B linear attention model on AWS Trainium2 with native PyTorch
items.summary: Learn how i14 trained and served Laplace 3B, a linear attention model, on AWS Trainium2 using native PyTorch. Its recurrent state stays fixed at 29.5 MB per sequence regardless of context length, avoiding the growing key-value cache of transformer models and keeping serving memory predictable.
items.zh: i14在AWS Trainium2上训练与部署Laplace 3B线性注意力模型
items.brief: AWS介绍i14用原生PyTorch在Trainium2上训练并部署Laplace 3B线性注意力模型，其循环状态固定为每序列29.5MB，不随上下文增长。

items.brief: AWS介绍Smartsheet MCP服务器在AWS上的两种接入方式：面向业务团队的Amazon Quick和面向开发者的Kiro。

items.title: From data to decisions: Conversational supply chain intelligence with Amazon Quick and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Enterprise supply chains are data-rich but insight-poor, with the data to decide scattered across ERP, monitoring, procurement, and email. items.title: Fine-tuning GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
items.summary: Learn how we fine-tuned GPT-OSS-20B for multilingual reasoning on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and how to decide between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with GRPO. SFT took reasoning-language accuracy from 22% to 100%, and GRPO added measurable gains where headroom existed.
items.zh: 在SageMaker HyperPod上微调GPT-OSS-20B多语言推理

items.summary: Hardcoded tool wiring breaks down as an agent's catalog grows from a handful of tools to hundreds. This post walks through a runtime Discover, Instantiate, Execute loop built on AWS Agent Registry, where an orchestrator discovers MCP servers and A2A agents through semantic search at runtime instead of compiling every tool at build time.

This reference architecture combines signed request envelopes, user-signed delegation assertions, RFC 8693 audience-scoped tokens, and real-time OCSP revocation to prove agent identity and prevent request forgery across agent-to-agent and MCP tool calls.

items.brief: AWS给出结合Keyfactor EJBCA的多代理加密身份参考架构，含签名请求信封、委托断言与实时吊销。
items.why: 代理身份与审计是合规落地前提，值得关注。

items.title: Structured outputs for Anthropic Claude models on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports structured outputs for all Anthropic Claude models on both the bedrock-runtime and bedrock-mantle endpoints. Receive schema-compliant JSON that conforms to a defined structure, without custom parsing, retry logic, or post-processing, using JSON Schema output format and strict tool use.
items.zh: Bedrock 为 Claude 模型支持结构化输出
items.brief: Amazon Bedrock 的 Claude 模型现支持结构化输出，按 JSON Schema 返回合规 JSON，无需自定义解析或重试。
items.why: 企业做 AI 应用集成时数据对接更稳，减少开发返工。

items.title: Developers can now access SageMaker Studio through the new AWS experience
items.summary: New Amazon SageMaker AI customers can now land in a fully configured SageMaker Studio environment in only a few steps. Sign up with an identity you already have, such as Amazon, Apple, GitHub, or Google, with no advanced AWS account or credit card required for most customers, plus $100 in AWS Free Tier credits.
items.zh: SageMaker Studio 推出全新上手体验
items.brief: 新用户可用现有账号几步进入配置好的 SageMaker Studio，多数无需信用卡，附 100 美元免费额度。
items.why: 降低企业试用门槛，但偏开发者工具，老板关注度有限。

items.title: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: 2026 year-to-date in review
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker JumpStart onboarded over 100 new models from 30 providers in the first three quarters of 2026. This recap covers the model-onboarding highlights and JumpStart enhancements, including the simplified Model Hub, pre-configured deployment options, and Hugging Face deep link integration.
items.zh: SageMaker JumpStart 2026 年进展回顾
items.brief: 前三季度 JumpStart 接入 30 家供应商的 100 多个新模型，并简化 Model Hub 与部署选项。
items.why: 模型选择更丰富，企业选型时可参考生态成熟度。

items.title: Germany Wants to Lead the World in Industrial AI: How NVIDIA Will Help
items.summary: In the cavernous hall of Kraftwerk, a former power station in Berlin, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang sat down to discuss Germany’s AI roadmap, and in particular, the industrial applications of AI. Huang opened by tracing NVIDIA’s longstanding relationship with German industry, beginning with gaming systems, workstations and automotive […]
items.zh: 英伟达与德国总理共商工业AI路线图
items.brief: 德国总理默茨与黄仁勋在柏林对话，讨论德国AI路线图及工业AI应用。
items.why: 工业AI成国家战略，制造业老板可关注AI改造生产的机会。

items.title: Pegasus 1.5 from TwelveLabs is now available in Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.5 is now available in Amazon Bedrock. The video language model turns long-form video into structured, timestamped metadata: define the moments that matter and get every matching segment back as JSON, with new video segmentation, multimodal prompting with reference images, and on-the-fly processing of up to two hours of video.
items.zh: TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.5上线亚马逊Bedrock
items.brief: 视频语言模型Pegasus 1.5在Bedrock可用，可将长视频转为带时间戳的结构化JSON元数据。
items.why: 视频内容自动结构化，适合有大量视频素材的企业做检索与剪辑。

items.title: How Deepgram optimized voice AI at scale with AWS Trainium
items.summary: Deepgram worked with the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering team to port its Nova-3 speech-to-text model to AWS Trainium2 for offline batch inference. This post covers porting to the AWS Neuron stack, kernel-level tuning, a data-parallel Rust runtime, and the throughput and cost results on batch transcription.
items.zh: Deepgram用AWS Trainium优化语音AI
items.brief: Deepgram将Nova-3语音转文字模型移植到Trainium2做离线批量推理，并公布吞吐与成本结果。
items.why: 语音转写成本与吞吐优化，客服、会议记录类应用可降本。

items.title: Push-based KV transfer to improve TTFT and TPOT for disaggregated inference in vLLM
items.summary: vLLM's prefill-decode disaggregation splits LLM inference across engine instances but must transfer the KV cache between them. This post introduces a push-based NIXL connector that moves transfer coordination off the critical path, delivering up to 3x better TTFT and 30% better TPOT in benchmarks on Amazon EC2 P5en instances with AWS EFA.
items.zh: vLLM推出推送式KV传输优化推理延迟
items.brief: vLLM引入基于NIXL的推送式连接器，将KV缓存传输移出关键路径，TTFT提升最高3倍。

items.title: Improve TTFT for multi-turn agentic workloads with bi-directional KV transfer in vLLM
items.summary: Multi-turn agentic workloads reprocess growing conversation context each turn, driving up latency. See how bi-directional KV cache transfer lets prefill and decode nodes reuse previously computed context across turns, cutting time to first token by up to 1.6x for Qwen3-32B and 3.3x for GLM-5-FP8 on Amazon EC2 P5en instances with EFA.
items.zh: vLLM双向KV传输降低多轮对话延迟
items.brief: 双向KV缓存传输让预填充与解码节点复用上下文，Qwen3-32B首字延迟最高降1.6倍。

items.title: NVIDIA Advances Agentic Security for Media, From European Public Service Broadcasting to Global Content Production
items.summary: At a creative industry event that took place today in Berlin — hosted in collaboration with Adobe, Bertelsmann, NVIDIA and UFA — the latest advancements in intelligent media were on display. Key to the news: the European Broadcasting Union (EBU) is collaborating with NVIDIA to expand its sovereign framework with cloud, open models and integration […]
items.zh: 英伟达推进媒体行业智能体安全
items.brief: 英伟达与Adobe、贝塔斯曼等合作，欧洲广播联盟将扩展其主权AI合作。
items.why: 媒体内容生产引入AI智能体，内容与传媒企业可关注合规与安全方案。

items.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI is improving ChatGPT across low-resource programming languages, with new evaluations for software engineering, SQLite, and COBOL migration.
items.zh: OpenAI 提升低资源编程语言能力
items.brief: OpenAI 介绍 ChatGPT 在低资源编程语言上的改进，新增软件工程、SQLite 和 COBOL 迁移评测。
items.why: 老系统迁移类场景或受益，可作企业遗留系统改造话题。

items.title: Structured Authority Injection: Persistent Human Control for LLM Agents via Typed MCP Overrides
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used as autonomous orchestrators in distributed and multi-agent systems, yet a control gap remains: no protocol-level mechanism allows human operators to inject binding directives that persist across planning cycles. Free-text overrides suffer from ambiguous interpretation due to lack of schema validation and from authority erosion as operator instructions lose influence within accumulating context. items.zh: 结构化权威注入：用MCP覆盖实现人类对LLM智能体的持久控制
items.brief: 论文提出通过类型化MCP覆盖机制，让人类指令在智能体规划周期中持续生效。
items.why: 提示企业AI智能体需保留人工干预与审批通道，可作为治理话题素材。

items.title: ECHOES: Seeing Beyond the Current Image via Recursive History Compression and Privileged On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22408v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon GUI agents rely on visual history to maintain task states, but retaining historical screenshots increases visual-token usage and inference costs, while textual summaries can discard critical state information, undermining long-horizon reliability. We propose ECHOES, which leverages training-time privileged information to guide textual history compression and strengthen long-horizon reasoning. items.zh: ECHOES：用递归历史压缩与特权在线蒸馏扩展GUI智能体
items.brief: 论文提出压缩视觉历史并蒸馏状态信息，降低长任务GUI智能体的推理成本。

items.title: Sensitivity Analysis of Decision Rules in an Agent-Based Agro-Ecological Model
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent-based models are well-suited for modelling agro-ecological systems for decision-making, yet turning their simulations into actionable insight requires identifying which decisions actually drive the behaviours. In such a context, sensitivity analysis stumbles upon a structural feature of many complex systems: the parameters are not a flat vector but a decision tree in which many parameters appear only when a higher-level choice activates them. items.zh: 农业生态智能体模型的决策规则敏感性分析
items.brief: 论文对智能体农业生态模型中的决策规则做敏感性分析，识别关键决策因素。

items.title: PRIME: Towards Verifiable Evidence-Grounded Reasoning in LLM Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents are used to check records against an organization's requirements, for example whether a vulnerability report is ready for investigation. Requirements often allow several ways to be met, such as a severity rating with a curator-reviewed advisory or a published advisory link. Agents fail by accepting a report after a required check has failed, or by settling for a weaker conclusion without trying another way that could still succeed. items.brief: 论文提出PRIME方法，使智能体按组织要求核查记录时给出可验证的证据依据。
items.why: 合规审查类AI应用的可信度问题，可作企业风控落地参考。

items.title: Author-in-the-loop Agentic Reproducibility Auditing for a Machine Learning Conference
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reproducibility checks during peer review require a shared understanding of what authors' code is expected to reproduce. We present an author-in-the-loop collaborative audit that makes author declarations explicit inputs to an AI agent's investigation and assessment. items.zh: 作者参与的智能体复现性审计：面向机器学习会议
items.brief: 论文提出让作者声明作为AI智能体审计输入的协作式复现性核查方法。

items.title: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Harness evolution automatically optimizes the prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration code around a fixed-weight model, offering a way to improve agentic systems without updating model weights. The agent harness is iteratively optimized to achieve higher performance on the search set. items.brief: 论文提出归因方法，分析提示、工具与编排代码优化各自带来的性能提升。

items.title: Testing the Planning Claims of LLM-Based Agents against Formal Semantics
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly credited with the competences of practical reasoning: planning, monitoring, and correcting their own actions. Their success is attributed to the prompting strategies and agent architectures built around the model, such as chain-of-thought, search-based prompting, self-refinement, reflection, critics and tool-using loops. items.brief: 论文以形式语义为基准，检验LLM智能体在规划、监控与纠错上的实际能力。
items.why: 提醒老板别高估智能体自主规划能力，可作预期管理素材。

items.title: FRACTAL: A Self-Similar Multi-Agent Orchestration Architecture with Formal Communication, Convergence, and Depth Bounds
items.summary: arXiv:2610.22561v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present FRACTAL, a self-similar multi-agent architecture for recursive goal decomposition, in which the same five-component organizational pattern -- Orchestrator, Ensemble, Knowledge Ledger, Decision Maker, Meta-Observer -- recurs at every level of a decomposition tree. items.zh: FRACTAL：自相似多智能体编排架构
items.brief: 论文提出递归目标分解的自相似多智能体架构，含通信、收敛与深度约束。

Starting at $2,399, laptops from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI bring powerful local AI, content creation and gaming capabilities to a portable device, with […]
items.zh: 英伟达RTX Spark笔记本上市，起价2399美元

items.title: Building trust in AI agents: A production-ready evaluation framework with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Autonomous AI agents fail softly: latency stays flat while answer quality quietly erodes. This post shares a nine-stage evaluation framework, built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, that catches silent quality regressions across the full agent lifecycle, from first commit to live production.
items.zh: AWS发布AI智能体生产级评估框架
items.brief: AWS基于Amazon Bedrock AgentCore推出九阶段评估框架，可捕捉智能体全生命周期中的隐性质量衰退。
items.why: 智能体上线后质量会悄悄下滑，企业需建立评估机制而非只看延迟指标。

items.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
items.summary: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

items.why: 金融等高监管行业如何兼顾AI落地与合规治理，可作标杆案例讲给老板。

items.title: Introducing Reflection Beam: an open-weight model for agentic coding on AWS
items.summary: Reflection AI's Beam is an open-weight model for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks. This post shows how to deploy Beam on AWS: start with an Amazon SageMaker JumpStart real-time endpoint, or use Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference with JumpStart, SGLang, or vLLM for Kubernetes-native control over distributed GPU infrastructure.
items.zh: AWS推出开源智能体编码模型Beam
items.brief: Reflection AI的Beam开源权重模型发布，用于智能体编码和长周期任务，可在AWS SageMaker上部署。
items.why: 企业可自部署编码智能体，降低对闭源API依赖，需评估运维成本。

items.title: The World Won't Wait: Evaluating and Teaching Agents Under a Live Clock
items.summary: arXiv:2610.20665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can solve complex interactive tasks, yet reasoning and tool calls take time. In continuously changing environments, an otherwise correct action may arrive too late. We introduce RealtimeBench, with 180 tasks across six game types, to evaluate agents while games continue running during inference. Paired evaluations show that GPT-6.1-sol outperforms the faster Jev when games are paused, but falls behind when they keep running. items.why: 提醒老板：AI响应速度可能成为业务落地瓶颈。

items.title: AlphaDiana: A Measurement System for Agents in Verifiable Reasoning Tasks
items.summary: arXiv:2610.20675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agents pair reasoning models with harnesses that organize model calls, execute tools, load skill instructions, and retain history in memory. Understanding agent performance requires linking execution conditions to outcomes, behavior, and resource use. We introduce AlphaDiana, a measurement system with modular interfaces for datasets, agents, environments, and scorers. items.zh: AlphaDiana：可验证推理智能体测量系统
items.brief: arXiv提出AlphaDiana，用于测量智能体在可验证推理任务中的执行条件与结果。

items.title: IneqAgent: Agentic Inequality Proving in Lean with Symbolic Computation

items.title: ARIA: Runtime Inspection and Amendment for Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: arXiv:2610.20780v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS), a local mistake can propagate as other agents build on it, turning a correctable error into a failed task. items.why: 多智能体协作出错可实时纠正，降低企业自动化风险。

items.title: EvolvingBrain: An Adaptive Skill System for Multi-modal Agents Self-Evolution in Open Worlds
items.summary: arXiv:2610.20786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-modal agents have made significant progress in interacting with open worlds. items.zh: SkillNEO：智能体技能的非精英进化优化

items.summary: Promoting Amazon Quick resources (agents, action connectors, knowledge bases, flows, and spaces) from a development to a production AWS account has been a manual, error-prone chore. items.summary: Multi-agent systems need deeper guarantees than fluent responses: they must select the right tools, respect constraints, and explain their decisions. items.title: Scaling MoE reinforcement learning on Amazon EKS with EFA and DeepEP with 40% more throughput
items.summary: Learn how to scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reinforcement learning on Amazon EKS using Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) and DeepEP. items.title: Accelerate multimodal RL training with SkyRL on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
items.summary: Learn how to run SkyRL, an open-source reinforcement learning framework, on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod to post-train a Qwen3-VL-8B vision-language model with GRPO. items.title: NarrateAI: production-ready LLM quality assurance on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: NarrateAI delivers production-ready LLM quality assurance on Amazon Bedrock.
